Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Ιουλίου, «Άγιοι Σίλας, Σιλουανός, Επαινετός, Κρήσκης και Ανδρόνικος οι Απόστολοι», with the rank words left off.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 iulie — «Sfinții Apostoli Sila, Silvan, Crescent, Epenet și Andronic»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Σίλας, Σιλουανός, Επαινετός, Κρήσκης και Ανδρόνικος οι Απόστολοι»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the entry is the same company of five the Romanian line names: «Οι Άγιοι Σίλας, Σιλουανός, Επαινετός, Κρήσκης και Ανδρόνικος, ήταν πέντε από τούς εβδομήκοντα μαθητές του Κυρίου». Four of the five take a greek row in this batch. The fifth, Andronicus, is the corpus's `andronicus-the-apostle`, whose greek row is already venerated on 17 May from saint.gr's own «Άγιοι Ανδρόνικος και Ιουνία οι Απόστολοι»; that row is not touched and this second Greek day of his is reported rather than drafted. The page gives no year or century for any of the five, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints two apolytikia, two kontakia, two megalynaria and a kathisma. The first apolytikion and the first kontakion are of the five together and are taken; the second apolytikion and the second kontakion name Silas alone and go to his folder only. The megalynaria and the kathisma are kinds the schema does not hold and are not drafted at all.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinţilor Apostoli Sila, Silvan, Crescent, Epenet şi Andronic», Glasul 3 — the common troparion the site prints for all five of the day

english.text: Holy Apostles, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of our sins.

hymns.text:
Cel Ce Te-ai înălţat pe Cruce...

Arătatu-v-aţi viţe ale Viei lui Hristos, înţelepţilor, aducând struguri în faptele cele bune, izvorându-ne nouă vinul mântuirii. Pe acesta primindu-l, ne umplem de veselie, prăznuind cinstită pomenirea voastră, în care rugaţi-vă pentru iertarea greşelilor noastre, Apostoli ai Domnului.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Condacul Sfinţilor Apostoli Sila, Silvan, Crescent, Epenet şi Andronic», Glasul 4, on the model «Cel Ce Te-ai înălţat pe Cruce» — the common kontakion the site prints for all five of the day

english.text:
O You who were lifted up on the Cross...

You were shown to be branches of the vine of Christ, O wise ones, bringing forth grapes in good works and pouring out for us the wine of salvation. Receiving it we are filled with gladness, keeping your honoured memory; on it pray for the forgiveness of our sins, O Apostles of the Lord.

hymns.text: Οἱ θεῖοι Ἀπόστολοι, ὡς οὐρανοὶ λογικοί, τὴν δόξαν ἀστράψαντες, τοῦ κενωθέντος ἐν γῇ, συμφώνως ὑμνείσθωσαν, Κρήσκης Σιλουναὸς τέ, καὶ ὁ ἔνθεος Σίλας, ἅμα σὺν Ἀνδρονίκω, Ἐπαινετὸς ὁ θεόφρων Χριστὸν γὰρ ἰκετεύουσι, σώζεσθαι ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page of the five apostles «Άγιοι Σίλας, Σιλουανός, Επαινετός, Κρήσκης και Ανδρόνικος οι Απόστολοι», and it names all five of them. The page spells Silouanos «Σιλουναὸς» here and the reading is copied as it stands

english.text: The divine Apostles, as rational heavens flashing out the glory of him who emptied himself upon earth, let them be hymned with one voice — Crescens and Silouanos, and the godly Silas together with Andronicus, and Epaenetus of godly mind; for they entreat Christ that all may be saved.

hymns.text: Εἰς τὰ τοῦ κόσμου δραμόντες πληρώματα, θεογνωσίας τὸν λόγον ἐσπείρατε· καὶ στάχυν πολύχουν δρεψάμενοι, τῷ Βασιλεῖ τῶν ἁπάντων προσήξατε, Ἀπόστολοι Χριστοῦ παναοίδιμοι.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τοῖς τῶν αἱμάτων σου — the first kontakion on the page of the five apostles «Άγιοι Σίλας, Σιλουανός, Επαινετός, Κρήσκης και Ανδρόνικος οι Απόστολοι». It names none of them singly and addresses the company, so it is the common of the five under whose names it is printed

english.text: Running out to the ends of the world, you sowed the word of the knowledge of God; and having reaped a harvest of many ears, you brought it to the King of all, all-renowned Apostles of Christ.

hymns.text: Συνοδίτης τοῦ Παύλου γεγονὼς καὶ συνέκδημος, τὴν Νεάπολιν μάκαρ καὶ Φιλίππους ἐφώτισας, τῆς θείας ἐπιγνώσεως φωτί, Ἀπόστολε Σίλα ἱερέ. Ἀλλὰ φύλαττε καὶ σκέπε πάντας ἡμᾶς, ἐν πίστει ἐκβοῶντάς σοι· δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐκπληροῦντι διὰ σοῦ, ἡμῶν τὰ αἰτήματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης — the second apolytikion on the page of the five apostles, and it names Silas alone

english.text: Having become Paul's companion on the road and his fellow traveller, you enlightened Neapolis and Philippi, blessed one, with the light of the divine knowledge, holy Apostle Silas. But guard and shelter all of us who cry out to you in faith: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who through you fulfils our petitions.

hymns.text: Ἐορτάζει σήμερον ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, τὴν ἁγίαν μνήμην σου, ἡ Ἐκκλησία τοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ ἐκβοᾷ σοι Ἀπόστολε· χαῖρε ὦ Σίλα τοῦ Παύλου συνόμιλε.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — the second kontakion on the page of the five apostles, and it names Silas alone

english.text: Today the Church of Christ keeps your holy memory with gladness and cries out to you, Apostle: hail, Silas, companion of Paul.
